contracts.signal: Half-year report commitments note (2026-06-30): Soulbrain has concluded long-term goods supply agreements with Samsung Electronics, Samsung Display, SK Hynix and LG Display and delivers products under them; Samsung Display is listed among the domestic semiconductor and display makers Soulbrain supplies with process chemicals. Display segment revenue H1 2026 KRW 26,582M (5% of group revenue; export KRW 20,117M / domestic KRW 6,465M), display material ASPs -11% vs FY2025; display chemical capacity 40,500 tons in H1, output 10,806 tons (27% utilisation). Amount attributable to Samsung Display not disclosed.
contracts.units: no specific figure (PO-based supply under annual/quarterly unit-price contracts, auto-renewing)
